== Summary ==
Slip “Scanner Techs” cut unchanged from page 6 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF file created 17 June 2023; [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf preserved copy]), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (594, 1234, 1106, 1519)). Version [[Scanner Techs (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
